columns.label: LTP
columns.tooltip: ⭐️ appears when LTP > 50DMA > 200DMA and price is within 5% of its 52-week low. Hover the star on a specific row for the exact reasoning. Edit the "Star Signal" hidden column's formula to change the rule.

columns.label: 🔔lert
columns.formula: (function(){ if(!ltp || !dayPivotP) return '-'; var isBuy=false, isSell=false; if(mtsScore>=3){ if(!(dailyDistToCeiling>2 && weeklyDistToCeiling>0 && weeklyDistToCeiling<0.5)) isBuy=true; } else if(mtsScore>=1){ if(!(dailyDistToCeiling>2 && weeklyDistToCeiling>0 && weeklyDistToCeiling<0.5)) isBuy=true; } else if(mtsScore>-1){ } else if(mtsScore>-3){ if(!(dailyDistToFloor>0 && dailyDistToFloor<1 && weeklyDistToFloor>2)) isSell=true; } else { isSell=true; } return (isBuy||isSell) ? dayPivotP : '-'; })()

columns.label: 📌arget
columns.formula: (function(){ if(!ltp || !dayPivotP) return '-'; var isBuy=false, isSell=false; if(mtsScore>=3){ if(!(dailyDistToCeiling>2 && weeklyDistToCeiling>0 && weeklyDistToCeiling<0.5)) isBuy=true; } else if(mtsScore>=1){ if(!(dailyDistToCeiling>2 && weeklyDistToCeiling>0 && weeklyDistToCeiling<0.5)) isBuy=true; } else if(mtsScore>-1){ } else if(mtsScore>-3){ if(!(dailyDistToFloor>0 && dailyDistToFloor<1 && weeklyDistToFloor>2)) isSell=true; } else { isSell=true; } if(isBuy){ if(ltp>=dayPivotR3) return 'Beyond R3'; if(ltp>=dayPivotR2) return dayPivotR3; if(ltp>=dayPivotR1) return dayPivotR2; return dayPivotR1; } if(isSell){ if(ltp<=dayPivotS3) return 'Beyond S3'; if(ltp<=dayPivotS2) return dayPivotS3; return dayPivotS2; } return '-'; })()

(function(){ if(!ltp || !hrPivotP) return '-'; var isTrap=false, isBearTrap=false, isSqueeze=false; if(mtsScore>=3){ if(dailyDistToCeiling>2 && weeklyDistToCeiling>0 && weeklyDistToCeiling<0.5) isTrap=true; } else if(mtsScore>=1){ if(dailyDistToCeiling>2 && weeklyDistToCeiling>0 && weeklyDistToCeiling<0.5) isTrap=true; } else if(mtsScore>-1){ if(((dailyDistToCeiling>0 && dailyDistToCeiling<1) || (dailyDistToFloor>0 && dailyDistToFloor<1)) && ((weeklyDistToCeiling>0 && weeklyDistToCeiling<1) || (weeklyDistToFloor>0 && weeklyDistToFloor<1))) isSqueeze=true; } else if(mtsScore>-3){ if(dailyDistToFloor>0 && dailyDistToFloor<1 && weeklyDistToFloor>2) isBearTrap=true; } function nearestCeiling(){ if(ltp>=hrPivotR3) return 'Beyond Hr R3'; if(ltp>=hrPivotR2) return hrPivotR3; if(ltp>=hrPivotR1) return hrPivotR2; if(ltp>=hrPivotP) return hrPivotR1; return hrPivotP; } function nearestFloor(){ if(ltp<=hrPivotS3) return 'Beyond Hr S3'; if(ltp<=hrPivotS2) return hrPivotS3; if(ltp<=hrPivotS1) return hrPivotS2; if(ltp<=hrPivotP) return hrPivotS1; return hrPivotP; } if(isTrap) return nearestCeiling(); if(isBearTrap) return nearestFloor(); if(isSqueeze) return (weeklyDistToCeiling<=weeklyDistToFloor) ? nearestCeiling() : nearestFloor(); return '-'; })()

columns.label: Star Signal
columns.formula: (!ltp || !fiftyDayAverage || !twoHundredDayAverage || !fiftyTwoWkLow) ? '' : ((ltp > fiftyDayAverage && fiftyDayAverage > twoHundredDayAverage && fiftyTwoWeekLowChangePercent <= 5) ? 'Uptrend (LTP>50DMA>200DMA) + near 52W low (≤5%). Possible entry zone — confirm on chart before acting.' : '')

columns.label: MTS Score
columns.formula: (function(){ var s=0; if(dayPivotR1 && ltp>dayPivotR1) s+=2; else if(dayPivotP && ltp>dayPivotP) s+=1; else if(dayPivotS1 && ltp<dayPivotS1) s-=2; else if(dayPivotP && ltp<dayPivotP) s-=1; if(hrPivotR1 && ltp>hrPivotR1) s+=1; else if(hrPivotP && ltp>hrPivotP) s+=0.5; else if(hrPivotS1 && ltp<hrPivotS1) s-=1; else if(hrPivotP && ltp<hrPivotP) s-=0.5; return s; })()

columns.label: Daily Ceil %
columns.formula: (function(){ if(!ltp||!dayPivotP) return '-'; var c=[dayPivotP,dayPivotR1,dayPivotR2,dayPivotR3].filter(function(v){return v&&v>ltp;}); if(!c.length) return '-'; var nr=Math.min.apply(null,c); return (((nr-ltp)/ltp)*100).toFixed(2); })()

columns.label: Daily Floor %
columns.formula: (function(){ if(!ltp||!dayPivotP) return '-'; var c=[dayPivotP,dayPivotS1,dayPivotS2,dayPivotS3].filter(function(v){return v&&v<ltp;}); if(!c.length) return '-'; var ns=Math.max.apply(null,c); return (((ltp-ns)/ltp)*100).toFixed(2); })()

columns.label: Weekly Ceil %
columns.formula: (function(){ if(!ltp||!hrPivotP) return '-'; var c=[hrPivotP,hrPivotR1,hrPivotR2,hrPivotR3].filter(function(v){return v&&v>ltp;}); if(!c.length) return '-'; var nr=Math.min.apply(null,c); return (((nr-ltp)/ltp)*100).toFixed(2); })()

columns.label: Weekly Floor %
columns.formula: (function(){ if(!ltp||!hrPivotP) return '-'; var c=[hrPivotP,hrPivotS1,hrPivotS2,hrPivotS3].filter(function(v){return v&&v<ltp;}); if(!c.length) return '-'; var ns=Math.max.apply(null,c); return (((ltp-ns)/ltp)*100).toFixed(2); })()

columns.label: Signal
columns.formula: (function(){ if(!ltp) return '-'; if(mtsScore>=3){ if(runwayDay>=2 && dailyDistToCeiling>1.5 && weeklyDistToCeiling>0) return '🚀 Strong Buy'; if(dailyDistToCeiling>2 && weeklyDistToCeiling>0 && weeklyDistToCeiling<0.5) return '⚠️ Trap/No-Trade'; return '🔼 Building Bullish'; } if(mtsScore>=1){ if(dailyDistToCeiling>2 && weeklyDistToCeiling>0 && weeklyDistToCeiling<0.5) return '⚠️ Trap/No-Trade'; return '🔼 Building Bullish'; } if(mtsScore>-1){ if(((dailyDistToCeiling>0 && dailyDistToCeiling<1) || (dailyDistToFloor>0 && dailyDistToFloor<1)) && ((weeklyDistToCeiling>0 && weeklyDistToCeiling<1) || (weeklyDistToFloor>0 && weeklyDistToFloor<1))) return '🌀 Squeeze/Coiling'; return '⚪ Neutral'; } if(mtsScore>-3){ if(dailyDistToFloor>0 && dailyDistToFloor<1 && weeklyDistToFloor>2) return '🪤 Bear Trap Risk'; return '🔽 Building Bearish'; } if(runwayDay>=2 && dailyDistToFloor>1.5 && weeklyDistToFloor>0) return '📉 Strong Sell'; return '🔽 Building Bearish'; })()
